goDecisionReasons: planned deterministic-readiness-eligible field count is 6, below the frozen minimum of 13
capability-adoption has no complete deterministic source for either field
infrastructure-deployment has no complete deterministic source for any field

fields.versionScope: catalog candidate at the collection cutoff
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Repository metadata, topics, manifests, paths, and prose cannot prove a complete architecture set.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every applicable taxonomy architecture must be affirmatively included or excluded under independent human review.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Review binds the immutable repository commit and catalog/taxonomy digests.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Positive machine declarations are incomplete and ordinary absence cannot close the field.

fields.versionScope: catalog candidate at the collection cutoff
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: README phrases, topics, descriptions, and path absence cannot prove a complete feature set.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every applicable taxonomy feature must be affirmatively included or excluded under independent human review.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Review binds the immutable repository commit and catalog/taxonomy digests.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: No bounded machine-readable upstream source declares the complete accepted feature vocabulary.

fields.versionScope: default-branch commit and mapped package version
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: A primary language or package manifest establishes positives only; omission does not prove no additional ecosystem.
fields.completenessRequirement: All applicable ecosystems must be closed, which the planned sources cannot guarantee.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Repository values bind the exact head commit; package values bind the exact version.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Positive declarations are useful evidence but do not close a multi-ecosystem set.

fields.versionScope: npm dist-tag latest resolved to an exact semantic version
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Mapped-package 404, malformed metadata, missing latest, or missing publish time is unknown; repo-only unmapped candidates are deterministic not-applicable.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete npm package payload, exact identity match, exact latest version, and version publish time.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Mutable registry collection cutoff and exact package version are retained.
fields.rationale: Exact package identity and latest-version metadata close every mapped package; catalog mapping closes repo-only not-applicability.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Missing optional engines, type, or exports properties are known structured omissions; unsupported values are unknown; repo-only candidates are not-applicable.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete exact-version npm metadata with retained engines.node, type, and exports declaration.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Exact package version is immutable; registry resolution cutoff is retained.
fields.rationale: The complete exact-version package document distinguishes property omission from source incompleteness.

fields.versionScope: exact package version or repository commit
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Dependency declarations may establish positives; absence cannot prove no compatibility.
fields.completenessRequirement: All supported frameworks must be closed, which dependency metadata cannot guarantee.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Exact package version or commit only.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Dependencies are neither a complete compatibility declaration nor proof of incompatibility.

fields.versionScope: exact package version or repository commit
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Dependency or deployment declarations establish positives only; absence cannot prove no datastore requirement.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every runtime-required datastore must be closed, which the planned manifests cannot guarantee across ecosystems.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Exact package version or commit only.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Machine-readable manifests are heterogeneous and incomplete negative authorities.

fields.versionScope: mapped package latest metadata at cutoff
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Complete repository-property omission is known undeclared; parsed disagreement is mismatched; source failure is unknown; repo-only candidates are not-applicable.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete exact-package npm payload and normalized package identity.
fields.rationale: Complete package metadata distinguishes undeclared linkage from unavailable authority.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Manifest and path absence cannot prove an empty complete infrastructure set.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every applicable infrastructure concept must be affirmatively classified under review.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Review binds exact version/commit and taxonomy digest.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: No universal complete machine-readable deployment authority exists for the catalog.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: No manifest can prove the complete set of optional integrations by omission.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every applicable optional infrastructure concept must be affirmatively classified under review.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Review binds exact version/commit and taxonomy digest.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Optionality is semantic and distributed across incomplete sources.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Deployment file presence is positive evidence only; absence cannot prove lack of self-hosting support.
fields.completenessRequirement: All applicable deployment modes must be classified under review.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Review binds exact version/commit and taxonomy digest.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Repository structure cannot close a deployment-mode taxonomy.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Paths and manifests can establish some primitives but cannot prove complete process, scheduling, and storage semantics.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every process role and both booleans must be closed under review.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: A complete operational model requires semantic judgment not supplied by a bounded universal manifest.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: NOASSERTION, null SPDX, endpoint absence, and missing license remain unknown and never become a favorable value.
fields.completenessRequirement: A recognized SPDX identifier closes a positive value; the current value type cannot represent legitimate no-detected-license absence.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Mutable default-branch snapshot and collection cutoff retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The positive rule is sound, but provider non-detection cannot close identity for every candidate.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: A complete archived=false property proves the negative at the snapshot; provider failure is unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact repository identity and complete Boolean archived property.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Mutable snapshot collectedAt is the effective as-of and carries source-is-mutable.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The provider property is total for a successfully resolved repository snapshot.

fields.versionScope: default-branch head and closed previous-90-day window
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: A complete zero-result commit window proves zero; missing pagination closure or provider failure is unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact repository/head identity, head commit time, and a pagination-closed commit count for the frozen window.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Window end equals collectedAt and head SHA is retained; source is mutable.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: A pre-registered closed time window and complete pagination summary can prove both zero and positive counts without prose.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: A complete empty first page is known no-release with three null value properties; excluded or truncated window results and temporary failure are unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact repository identity and a pagination-closed release set; the bounded five-record window cannot guarantee this for every repository.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Mutable repository release snapshot carries collectedAt/effectiveAsOf.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The successor fixes complete-empty handling without rewriting Phase 8, but bounded pagination cannot close every repository.

fields.versionScope: exact mapped npm package version at cutoff
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: A complete zero-result query is known zero with null highest severity; partial pagination or provider failure is unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact package/version query and pagination completeness; repository-only candidates cannot be closed because the field registry does not permit not-applicable.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The additive successor correctly preserves complete zero results for mapped packages, but package advisory authority cannot close repository-only candidates.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: A complete provider Boolean false proves absence at the snapshot; endpoint absence/failure is unknown unless the normalized property is complete.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact repository identity and complete security_policy Boolean.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Mutable snapshot collectedAt is retained with source-is-mutable.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: A successor preserves established controlled absence as present=false; the Phase 8 projector treated that accepted absence as unknown.
